data.narrative:
Cortical Labs is a Series A-stage AI & Software company that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers: Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B). The broader comp set includes 9 private firms and 1 public company (Palantir).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $22M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 comparables yields a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $25.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in peer trajectories and market positioning.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $19M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The substantial spread between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects uncertainty around whether Cortical Labs' trajectory aligns with the upper-tier performers (Reflection AI) or the more modestly valued Series B cohort. Key uncertainties include product validation, revenue traction, and technical differentiation relative to the peer set.
